protocol.acceptance: A finite recurrent oscillator cluster passes if full recurrence <=14 and the predeclared complete-state halo bound hold through42. This does not certify physical binding, motion, source-created attachment or spontaneous emergence.
protocol.failure: A finite counterexample rejects the stated motif/phase/tensor halo or recurrence criterion. Budget exhaustion is inconclusive.
protocol.fixed_signs: All eight triples in {-1,+1}^3, chosen once before each trajectory.

initial_preparation.channel14: Negate channel0 a,b and use remainder4.
initial_preparation.halo: Starts at background; is never injected or corrected during evolution.
initial_preparation.positions: One site at (L//2,L//2,L//2), or that site and its +x neighbor.

protocol.next_decisive_test: Prospectively test a signal-created cluster with inert source-absent control and a full-state postarrival interface that includes the source/guide wake.

observations.boundary: Minimum distance of any active spatial coordinate to a cube face over all sampled states. A positive distance excludes use of a wrapped port by active values in the sampled transitions.
observations.halo: Every nonbackground address lies within toroidal Manhattan distance <=1 of an initially prepared motif site, including every retained remainder.
observations.interaction: For each adjacent motif, first target-triple difference from the matching separately evolved isolated motif; no independent factorization is inferred from a single equality.
observations.inverse: All one-step inverses and full final-to-initial rewind must be exact.
observations.recurrence: First full-state equality to initial state at t=1,...,14, then repeated equality S(t)=S(t+p) for every sampled pair through t42.

protocol.question: Do isolated and adjacent prepared clock motifs retain their complete recurrent state in a fixed radius-one halo on fresh cube sizes and counter phases?
protocol.registration: Written after v1 exposed retained-state halos and before v2 cases were computed; no v1 result is revised.
